author: reek
body: Probe: a board driver's register access cannot be laundered through a pure signature.

author: reek
body: This is the companion to cap-launder-pure-mmio, and it exists because that probe passed for months while the thing it protects was wide open. cap-launder-pure-mmio calls the intrinsics directly, so it proved only that the intrinsics carry Device.Mmio. It could not see that the nine board chapters -- the only code in the tree that actually drives a register -- sat on the type checker's quire-effect-exemption list and were never checked at all. A driver typed `Integer -> Integer` read and wrote RCC, and nothing complained.

author: reek
body: So this probe goes through the driver, not around it. stm32-gpio-enable-port declares [Device.Mmio]; blink wants to be pure. The effectful call cannot hide in a plain let (CDX2033) and the effect is not declared in the signature (CDX2031).
